base.rule: split_v4 copied unchanged (dev / sealed / exclude / label_key / second_labeller / masked_ball_sources / score_rule / fixed_camera_sources) except deg_profile = refD3_ext and no train_equivalent

score_rule_note: pff (broadcast-derived tracking: off-camera players provider-ESTIMATED, camera-away in 81% of dead vs 13% of alive frames) is scored for H/A skill only: team segmentation given the TRUE stoppages (oracle_dead: GT D frames unscored and splitting the runs, predicted D = abstention, filled with the predicted team inside each GT-alive run). Dead-ball decisions on pff are camera-confounded in both directions (E090), so they can earn no credit; dead-ball skill is judged on the fixed-camera sources idsse-ctrl / stv2 (all frames, as v3). A camera-on mask (pff scored > 5 s from any camera-away frame) was the first design (pre-registered 5 s) and was dropped after the E090 diagnostics (dry runs only, no ledger line): the pff-trained dead members still gained +0.013 on camera-on pff (decaying with the mask width 0/2/5/10 s: +0.032/+0.017/+0.013/+0.010) with no fixed-camera support (FC +0.001), and 45% of alive pff player-frames are ESTIMATED even with the camera on, so masking cannot remove the fingerprint; it also discarded 70% of pff frames. The decision was made on mechanism (pff dead decisions are confounded wherever players are estimated), and it is stated here that the dry-run deltas were seen first.
gate_rule: avo_gate_v4: v3 statistics (gate_v2) on the v4 scores + fixed-camera group condition: FC = mean(mean delta idsse-ctrl, mean delta stv2) >= 0 (per-source regression guard as v3).
note: NOT an evaluator / gate split: input-type comparison only (Track D v3 + kinematic-prior refined ball, E097b). Training AND evaluation views degraded by mtah.degrade_refD3_ext (refiner errors measured on external SoccerTrack v2 video); run through mtah.run_refD.
